variable.name: gtrd
variable.definition: Deviation of ratio of government transfers to GDP from trend ratio

standard_equation.eviews_equation: gtrd - gtrd_aerr = y_gtrd(2)*xgap2 + y_gtrd(3)*(xgap2(-1)+xgap2(-2)+xgap2(-3)+xgap2(-4))/4 + y_gtrd(1)*(gtrd(-1) - y_gtrd(2)*xgap2(-1) - y_gtrd(3)*(xgap2(-2)+xgap2(-3)+xgap2(-4)+xgap2(-5))/4) + y_gtrd(4)*gfdrt + y_gtrd(5)*((gfdbtnp(-1)/xgdpn(-1)) - gfdrt(-1))
